claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on a narrow launch-readiness basis despite a known segment-specific evaluation gap, open legal disclosure review, and unresolved materiality dispute.
decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence shows the certification satisfies the release policy threshold.
A weakness is material if it affects a contractual customer segment or named launch use case.
Material limitations for named launch use cases must be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents are supportive but not sufficient when a specific material-policy requirement is unresolved.
Public governance guidance may support monitoring and documentation practices, but it does not satisfy missing internal policy predicates.
evidence_requests: Evidence that the merchant dispute support limitation was disclosed in the required pre-launch artifact.
Evidence of an approved risk acceptance covering this specific material limitation before launch.
A final legal determination closing the open disclosure review ticket.
Evidence showing the affected segment is not a named launch use case or contractual customer segment, if that is being asserted.
specific_concerns: The affected merchant dispute support segment misses target and is named in two marketplace renewal commitments, which makes the weakness material under the provided policy text.

The release policy requires material limitations for named launch use cases to be disclosed unless resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance before launch, and no evidence shows disclosure, resolution, or approved risk acceptance.
Legal review on whether disclosure is required is still open, so a required policy predicate remains unresolved.
The actor relies on aggregate readiness and generic public governance guidance, but those do not override the specific internal disclosure policy for material limitations.
Product's 'non-core' or low-volume characterization does not resolve materiality when named commitments are involved.
unsupported_claims: That certification is policy-compliant despite the unresolved material limitation.
That the existing evidence is sufficient to support certification rather than merely documenting a residual risk dispute.
Any implication that generic model-card or AI-risk-management guidance can substitute for the required disclosure or approved risk acceptance under the release policy.
